expresion: Hit the nail on the head
traduccion: Acertar en el blanco, dar justo en el clavo.
registro: Informal/formal (Se puede usar en contextos formales pero suena más coloquial)
definicion: Acierta exactamente y sin equivocarse con algo; entender o describir una situación de manera precisa e inmediata.
ejemplos: The new marketing strategy hit the nail on the head, as consumer feedback was overwhelmingly positive.
She really hit the nail on the head when she suggested improving customer service.

traduccion: Algo fue despertado o provocado por
definicion: Esta expresión se utiliza para indicar que un sentimiento, un problema o una controversia fue causado o desatado por una persona o evento específico.
ejemplos: A heated debate about the new policy was stirred up by the speech given by the mayor.
The controversy surrounding the new development project was stirred up by environmental activists.

definicion: Esta frase se utiliza para indicar que el éxito o el logro estuvieron determinados por un factor o circunstancia específica.
ejemplos: Success lay in her ability to adapt to new challenges and continue learning.
He realized that success lay in focusing on quality rather than quantity.

definicion: Expresar que tiene justificación lógica o moral para algún acto o creencia
ejemplos: After reviewing the evidence, the judge concluded that the defendant was justified in defending himself.
She argued that employees are justified in seeking better working conditions and fair compensation.

definicion: Esta expresión se utiliza para indicar que algo crea obstáculos o dificultades en una situación.
ejemplos: The excessive bureaucracy at the office makes it difficult to implement new ideas.
Language barriers can make it difficult to communicate effectively with clients from other countries.

traduccion: Estoy un poco enfermo o indispuesto
definicion: Una expresión coloquial que se utiliza para indicar que uno se siente un poco enfermo o no se encuentra bien.
ejemplos: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I might have to take the day off.
My head is really hurting, and I'm under the weather at the moment.

traduccion: Estar al borde de la decisión
registro: En el C2 penalizan mezclar expresiones coloquiales en textos formales.
definicion: A phrase used to describe a situation where someone is indecisive or undecided about a choice, often metaphorically referring to standing on the edge of a fence that one wishes not to cross.
ejemplos: His decision about which university to attend is best described as being on the fence.
We were on the fence about whether to attend the party or study for the exam.
I'm still on the fence about which job to accept, but I think I'll consider it carefully.

definicion: Una expresión coloquial que se utiliza para describir la habilidad de hacer que alguien se sienta relajado y cómodo cuando interactúa con ellos
ejemplos: The teacher put the shy child at ease by laughing at his jokes.
Her calming tone put the scared customers at ease during the presentation.

registro: en el C2 penalizan mezclar expresiones coloquiales en textos formales
definicion: Una expresión informal que se usa al hacer algo que necesita una pausa o que el hablante está prestando atención a lo que está diciendo
ejemplos: Don't put that down yet. We still have a lot to discuss.
Put that down for now. I want to think about it for a while.
Please put that down for now. It's not the right time.

registro: En el C2 penalizan mezclar expresiones coloquiales en textos formales.
definicion: Una expresión que describe la situación de ser involuntariamente afectado por una situación
ejemplos: The new law has made it easier for victims of domestic violence to seek legal help.
She felt like a victim of circumstance when she couldn't find a job after graduation.

definicion: Es una frase utilizada en inglés para expresar la idea de estar atento a posibles amenazas o situaciones inesperadas.
ejemplos: To be on the lookout for any suspicious activity.
We need to be on the lookout for any potential threats.
The team is on the lookout for any new developments in the investigation.

traduccion: No poner a alguien a hablar
definicion: Exprime o interrumpe el discurso de alguien
ejemplos: He stifled the speaker's voice so the class could not hear him.
The teacher stifled the student's voice when she caught him talking during the test.

definicion: En el C2, penalizan mezclar expresiones coloquiales en textos formales. Overt/subtle retaliation se utiliza en contextos informales, pero en un texto formal se debería usar una expresión menos coloquial como 'directo/indirecto venganza'.
ejemplos: The company decided to take overt retaliation against the employees who were involved in the scandal.
She decided to give them a subtle retaliation for the way they treated her.
The company took an overt retaliation against the employees who were involved in the scandal.
She gave them a subtle retaliation for the way they treated her.

traduccion: No hay traducción necesaria, ya que es una expresión colovida común en inglés.
registro: en el C2 penalizan mezclar expresiones coloquiales en textos formales
definicion: Esta expresión se utiliza para indicar que alguien está atento a o consciente de algo o alguien.
ejemplos: To be tuned into the issue to understand the full implications of the situation.
I need to be tuned into the details of the project before the presentation.
I'm going to be tuned into the conversation to catch any important details.

definicion: Instrucción o alegato que impulsa o anima a alguien a mejorar su capacidad, conocimientos o habilidades
ejemplos: It is important to sharpen yourself up before the exam to ensure you are fully prepared.
I am determined to sharpen myself up to achieve my goals in this new job.
You need to sharpen yourself up for the interview, so you can make a good impression.

traduccion: consistir en mantenerse al margen por muy poco
definicion: La frase 'scrape by' significa obtener solo lo suficiente para mantenerse a flote o sobrevivir, generalmente en un contexto de trabajo duro o de salario insuficiente.
ejemplos: We work all day and end up scraping by on a part-time job to make ends meet.
The small business scraped by on the profits from selling used clothes and furniture.
Despite putting in long hours, the factory workers were only scraping by due to their meager wages and benefits.
The struggling artist managed to scrape by on the royalties from her art, barely enough to cover her living expenses.

definicion: Expresar la acción de dirigir un vehículo, generalmente un automóvil.
ejemplos: He decided to steer the car towards the nearest gas station.
Can you help me steer the car in a more direct path?
She has been steering the car for a few hours now.
He's not a very good car driver, so he's having trouble steering it properly.
